Store staff are strict about pet welfare (which is good), but they are selling Exo Terra analog dials (see photos) that are dangerously inaccurate. Tested against a calibrated fridge and a 100% humidity environment: the thermometer is 5°C off and the hygrometer is 30% off. If you rely on these for a reptile, you could accidentally kill it. This is a product fault, not a staff fault, but it's DANGEROUS for pet owners."

Disgrace of a vet company and store. Unknowledgeable and Untrained vet staff and rude receptionists. Do not bring your pets here!! These vets killed my perfectly healthy cat Mila who had just turned 6 years old, I had taken her to this vet every year for her booster and her health check ups where she’d leave in perfect condition but this last time (last month) the vet said she had some plaque on her back teeth and said she needs a dental scale and polish to avoid further damage. I asked if there’s anything else I can give her first rather than doing this procedure as she had never had anything like this done before as she was a perfectly healthy cat but the vet said no she needs this done first. I listened to the vet as you think they’re advising what’s best for your pet when now I know in reality they’re just money Hungry greedy scum. I took her in for her scale and polish appointment thinking she’ll be fine this is just a minor procedure, I then got a horrifying call a few hours later saying she had stopped breathing at the end of the treatment and there was nothing they could do to resuscitate her. We were all distraught never did we think something like this would happen to our girl, they said they don’t know how she passed and have no explanation????? Just that she may have reacted badly to the anaesthetic which I think is a complete lie god knows what they done to her and said she was one in one thousand this could happen to. Please protect your pets and don’t bring them here, since our experience I have heard other bad stories about this specific store I really wish I had done better research on this place before going ahead with anything all they care about is money and not the safety or health of your pets, we have now lost our little girl and are still grieving but hope we can help others avoid this ever going through this.
